question.problem: Calculate the $x$-coordinates of the points where the hyperbola $\frac{{y}^{2}}{5}-\frac{{x}^{2}}{25}=1$ intersects the line $y=-x.$
question.worked_solution:
To find the points where the hyperbola intersects the line $y=-x,$ we first replace $y$ with $-x$ in the equation of the hyperbola and solve for $x,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{{y}^{2}}{5}-\frac{{x}^{2}}{25} & =1 \\ \frac{(-x)^{2}}{5}-\frac{{x}^{2}}{25} & =1 \\ \frac{{x}^{2}}{5}-\frac{{x}^{2}}{25} & =1 \\ \frac{5{x}^{2}}{25}-\frac{{x}^{2}}{25} & =1 \\ \frac{4{x}^{2}}{25} & =1 \\ {x}^{2} & =\frac{25}{4} \\ x & =\pm \frac{5}{2}\end{aligned}
$$
